name: Sidebar
looksLike: column of links down the left side
menu that stays beside the main content
vertical list of sections along the edge of a page
definition: A side column that keeps navigation or supporting information beside the main content instead of covering it.

notConfusedWith.difference: Slides over the page and may use a backdrop; a sidebar occupies space beside content.

prompts.short: Add a sidebar with labeled navigation and a marked current link.
prompts.detailed: Add a sidebar beside the main content using a labeled navigation landmark. Mark the current page link, keep links at least 44px high, and show keyboard focus. Stack the navigation above content on narrow screens so the layout does not overflow.
